testCase: TC-E2E-41 narrow landscape seat-map keyboard focus visibility
testTitle: narrow landscape seat map scrolls keyboard focus into view
fixture: 6 seat rows by 24 columns (144 available seats), which overflows horizontally and vertically

environment.application: Vite production preview built from source e1e8bc6 at http://127.0.0.1:5190

assertions: Keyboard Tab moves focus through the seat buttons to the last seat.
The seat-map scrollport scrolls on both axes (scrollTop > 0 and scrollLeft > 0).
The focused seat border box stays within all four scrollport content edges and all four viewport edges.
